cases.title: Open a canonical DocForge project
cases.user_goal: Prove directory and manifest project entry use the strict DocForge v1 contract.
preconditions: The repository test fixtures and Python environment are available.
steps: Run project model, loader, and application project service tests. Expected: Canonical directories and docforge.yaml open while bare Markdown and obsolete manifests are rejected.
expected_results: The strict DocForge project entry contract passes.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a1-project-open does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Verify repository and release delivery contracts
cases.user_goal: Prove active repository surfaces and local release artifacts use DocForge identities and neutral filenames.
preconditions: Repository facticity, distribution, and local release artifacts are available.
steps: Run facticity, desktop distribution, and release metadata validation. Expected: Active findings remain zero and local release artifacts satisfy DocForge naming and integrity rules.
expected_results: Repository-owned and local release surfaces use the DocForge delivery contract.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a10-repository-delivery does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Build a general DocForge project
cases.user_goal: Prove a neutral general project completes inspect, validate, review, and build without academic metadata.
preconditions: The docforge-general fixture and Python environment are available.
steps: Copy the general fixture to an isolated directory and run all four CLI operations. Expected: All operations succeed and create neutral Review and DOCX outputs.
expected_results: The general project completes the neutral offline flow without academic requirements.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a2-general-project does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Build an academic profile without global leakage
cases.user_goal: Prove academic fields are typed and template-scoped while general documents remain valid.
preconditions: The academic and general fixtures are available.
steps: Run template, compiler, project, and distribution profile tests. Expected: Academic builds pass and general builds remain free of academic requirements.
expected_results: Academic profile requirements do not leak into general projects.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a3-academic-profile does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Reject obsolete ThesisForge contracts
cases.user_goal: Prove obsolete active identities are absent or rejected without aliases.
preconditions: Repository facticity rules and obsolete-input tests are available.
steps: Run obsolete-domain tests and the repository facticity scan. Expected: All negative contracts are rejected and active finding count is zero.
expected_results: No obsolete ThesisForge contract remains active.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a4-obsolete-contracts does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Use neutral source, build, and Review defaults
cases.user_goal: Prove canonical filenames match across project, CLI, runtime, and desktop contracts.
preconditions: CLI, project, protocol, and distribution tests are available.
steps: Run project, CLI, contract, and desktop distribution default-path tests. Expected: All layers use document.md and neutral document output paths.
expected_results: Canonical neutral default paths match across all product layers.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a5-neutral-default-paths does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Enforce project path security
cases.user_goal: Prove safe project-relative resources are accepted and unsafe path classes are rejected.
preconditions: Project loader and application path-security tests are available.
steps: Run project path and application service redteam tests. Expected: Absolute, remote, traversal, and symlink-escape paths fail with stable diagnostics.
expected_results: All unsafe project path classes are rejected without weakening safe relative paths.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a6-path-security does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Preserve the deterministic DOCX pipeline
cases.user_goal: Prove semantic ordering, renderer boundaries, OOXML structures, cancellation, deterministic output, and atomic replacement.
preconditions: Core, compiler, renderer, application, and deterministic-output tests are available.
steps: Run core, compiler, DOCX renderer, acceptance, and build lifecycle tests. Expected: The ordered deterministic pipeline and real OOXML structures pass.
expected_results: The semantic-to-DOCX pipeline remains deterministic, ordered, cancelable, and atomic.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a7-deterministic-docx does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Keep Python, TypeScript, Rust, HTTP, and Tauri protocol parity
cases.user_goal: Prove all runtime boundaries use one strict versioned DocForge protocol and BuildReport identity.
preconditions: Python, frontend, and Rust dependencies are installed in the verification worktree.
steps: Run focused Python adapters, frontend transport tests, real HTTP acceptance, and Rust protocol tests. Expected: All runtimes accept canonical identities and reject obsolete or malformed protocol data.
expected_results: The versioned DocForge runtime and BuildReport contract is consistent across all boundaries.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a8-runtime-parity does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.

cases.title: Verify installed DocForge and Microsoft Word preview evidence
cases.user_goal: Prove the installed macOS workbench uses neutral terminology and generated a valid Word PDF preview.
preconditions: The content-addressed installed acceptance receipt and screenshot are present.
steps: Validate the installed app receipt, Microsoft Word result, accessibility labels, and screenshot SHA-256. Expected: The receipt is passed, Word preview is available, and the screenshot matches its recorded hash.
expected_results: Installed DocForge.app and Microsoft Word final preview evidence is internally consistent and content-addressed.
boundary_cases: Preserve failure evidence if case-a9-installed-office does not satisfy its deterministic oracle.
